proofs.text: Run init on a project holding an xunit `.csproj` and verify the output contains `TestLogger.dll` and `dotnet test --logger purlin`; run it on a vitest project and verify the output names Stryker

reasons: PROOF-9 happy_path_only: No proof of this rule names a rejection, an error or a boundary.
rule_text: A framework whose tooling init cannot wire is told what to do instead: an xunit project that its logger needs a `*.TestLogger.dll` assembly and `dotnet test --logger purlin`, and a node project that Stryker is what measures the breaks

tests.body:
def test_xunit_is_told_how_to_wire_its_logger(self):
        made = Project('xunit')
        try:
            output = made.run('--gate', 'tested')
            assert 'TestLogger.dll' in output
            assert 'dotnet test --logger purlin' in output
        finally:
            made.close()
tests.name: test_a_node_project_is_told_about_stryker
